newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy industrialist leader says wants rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Italy industrialist leader says wants rate cut.

text.p: Giogio Fossa, head of Italy's industrialists group Confindustra, said on Wednesday he hoped the Bank of Italy would cut the discount rate soon.
"We hope it happens as soon as possible," he told reporters in response to a question.
Market hopes for another rate cut have been fuelled by forecasts that inflation will continue to fall in April.
Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi has said he was convinced year-on-year inflation in Italy would fall to below two percent for April.

The March year-on-year level was 2.2 percent, the lowest since 1969, and preliminary consumer price data for April from 11 Italian cities are due to be released on April 21 and 22. ISTAT will publish final CPI data for April on May 6.
The central bank last cut the discount rate on January 21, when it was reduced by 75 basis points to 6.75 pct.
